baseline_settings.gurobi: defaults + Threads, TimeLimit, Seed, MIPGap=0; size-limited licence (vars <= 2000 and constraints <= 2000)
baseline_settings.highs: defaults + threads, time_limit, random_seed, mip_rel_gap=0 (logging on but silent so that the logging callback fires)
baseline_settings.execution: one run at a time, each in its own process; trace time is wall-clock from the optimize call
